title: bot.ability.hearing.sound.classification.input
description: One sound for SoundClassification to label (mosfet.py's SoundClassification input).

id.description: The requester's id for this request, echoed by the reply.
id.title: Id

audio.description: Reference (a URI reference) to the audio this stimulus carries; floppy passes media by reference, never as bytes [floppy field].
audio.title: Audio

media_type.description: Optional media type or codec label, such as audio/pcm or audio/opus.
media_type.title: Media Type

kind.description: Optional low-cardinality acoustic provenance hint. Prefer domain-qualified labels when the source is clear (for example phone.ringing, phone.call, ambient, knock) so models do not confuse bare tokens like ring. Not a linguistic interpretation.
kind.title: Kind
